backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows for core baseline, plus production paper-sleeve replay over the same OHLCV snapshots. Core replay uses REPLAY_PARTIAL_REDUCES and REGIME_AWARE_EXIT.

gate.rule: Pass if aggregate EV and sleeve PnL improve, EV and PnL improve in all three windows, max drawdown worsens by no more than 0.5 percentage points in any window, sleeve closed trades >= 40, and auxiliary earnings 8-K closed trades >= 10.

hypothesis: Inside the accepted SEC financial-report T+1 paper sleeve, earnings 8-K rows with auxiliary disclosure items beyond 2.02/9.01 may have a different event-quality profile than clean earnings 8-K rows, so they may deserve a separate paper-notional scalar.
next_evidence_needed: Do not retry auxiliary earnings 8-K notional scalars on this frozen sample; future SEC work needs forward outcomes or a genuinely new earnings-quality field.

parameters.auxiliary_earnings8k_definition: event_family == earnings_8k and item_codes contain any item outside {2.02, 9.01}

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: use existing SEC item_codes semantics to scale paper notional only for auxiliary-item earnings 8-K rows.
protocol_answers.2_history_check: exp-20260512-011 tested clean earnings 8-K notional and failed because late_strong regressed; exp-20260512-020 accepted 10-Q notional; exp-20260512-025/033 rejected queue priority and paired-filing dedupe. No logged experiment isolated auxiliary item earnings 8-K notional on the accepted 10-Q stack.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance_standard: Pass if aggregate EV and sleeve PnL improve, EV and PnL improve in all three windows, max drawdown worsens by no more than 0.5 percentage points in any window, sleeve closed trades >= 40, and auxiliary earnings 8-K closed trades >= 10.

rejection_reason: No auxiliary earnings 8-K scalar cleared the three-window semantic risk-allocation gate.
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking remains sample-limited, Space has just accepted multiple default-off risk scalars and should wait for forward replacement value, and SEC floor/hold/global-notional/10-Q-priority/paired-dedupe variants already have anti-repeat records.
